newsitem.title: CANADA: World Wide Minerals restarts uranium mill.
newsitem.headline: World Wide Minerals restarts uranium mill.

text.p: World Wide Minerals Ltd said on Thursday it restarted commercial production of uranium at the TGK mill in Kazakstan and initiated its first sale of uranium.
World Wide Minerals said the mill commenced operation on March 21 and the first ore was introduced to the crushing and processing circuits earlier this week.

The company said its first deal for the sale of U308 on the international uranium market is for a total of about 20 percent of 1997 production. The sale is for delivery to a U.S. electric power utility in the fourth quarter of 1997.
